Hi Laura / team —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers inline below: 

1) RTMP endpoints / handshake: ON24 can provide regional egress endpoints for US / EU / APAC. We support primary RTMP + backup RTMP within a single session. Typical handshake timeout is 30s; recommend clients send an initial keepalive every 20s. We'll send the exact hostnames in a follow-up secure note (can't publish public DNS here).

2) Registration fields: ON24 registration forms allow up to 500 characters for custom copy in the checkbox helper text; the visible label should be under 150 characters for mobile. Your attached copy looks fine but please shorten the visible label to a single sentence; helper text can include the fuller legal wording.

3) Recording delivery / watermarking: We can generate sponsor-watermarked MP4s on export. Retention defaults to 180 days; we can set a 90-day partner access window for sponsor downloads and then move the asset to cold storage. Delivery options: S3 push or Drive link.

Next steps: we'll open a secure ticket with the egress hostnames and recommended keepalive parameters. For testing, suggest two dry run windows: Dec 3 (08:00–11:00 PST) and Dec 6 (22:00–01:00 PST) to cover APAC.

Regards,
ON24 Onboarding Team
onboarding@on24.com
